Rules.InvariantScript:
Set(varNavArm, "");
ClearCollect(colValidations,
    {Check: "Media type is set",
     Pass: Not(IsBlank(varChildMediaType)) And varChildMediaType <> "",
     Note: "Select a production type on the Info tab."},
    {Check: "Archive title is provided",
     Pass: Not(IsBlank(varChildTitle1)) And varChildTitle1 <> "" And varChildTitle1 <> "New archive",
     Note: "Enter a descriptive title on the Info tab."},
    {Check: "Capture / production date is set",
     Pass: Not(IsBlank(varChildCaptureDate)),
     Note: "Set the date on the Info tab (Metadata tab for Photo/Reportage)."},
    {Check: "Language version(s) selected (Video / Podcast only)",
     Pass: (varChildMediaType <> "Video" And varChildMediaType <> "Podcast") Or (Not(IsBlank(varChildLanguageVersions)) And varChildLanguageVersions <> ""),
     Note: "Select the language on the Info tab (Video) or Metadata tab (Podcast)."},
    {Check: "No AI-generated voice-over (not accepted)",
     Pass: Not(varChildAIVoiceover),
     Note: "⛔ AI voice-over detected. This archive cannot be submitted."},
    {Check: "Contract case (1–6) is selected",
     Pass: Not(IsBlank(varChildContractCase)) And varChildContractCase <> "",
     Note: "Select a contract case on the Legal & Docs tab."},
    {Check: "Case 1: both mandatory contracts confirmed", Pass: Left(varChildContractCase, 6) <> "Case 1" Or (varDocFramework And varDocSpecific), Note: "Confirm the signed framework and specific contracts on the Legal & Docs tab."},
    {Check: "Contractor / agency provided (Photo only)",
     Pass: varChildMediaType <> "Photo" Or (Not(IsBlank(varChildCredits1)) And varChildCredits1 <> ""),
     Note: "Enter the contractor / agency on the Metadata tab."},
    {Check: "Description provided (Photo only)",
     Pass: varChildMediaType <> "Photo" Or (Not(IsBlank(varChildDescription1)) And varChildDescription1 <> ""),
     Note: "Enter the description on the Info tab."},
    {Check: "Place provided (Photo only)",
     Pass: varChildMediaType <> "Photo" Or (Not(IsBlank(varChildProductionPlace1)) And varChildProductionPlace1 <> ""),
     Note: "Enter the place on the Metadata tab."},
    {Check: "Photo caption provided (Photo only)", Pass: varChildMediaType <> "Photo" Or (Not(IsBlank(varChildPhotoCaption)) And varChildPhotoCaption <> ""), Note: "Enter the photo caption on the Metadata tab."},
    {Check: "Contracting authority provided (Photo only)",
     Pass: varChildMediaType <> "Photo" Or (Not(IsBlank(varChildContractingAuthority)) And varChildContractingAuthority <> ""),
     Note: "Enter the contracting authority on the Metadata tab."},
    {Check: "Podcast title provided (Podcast only)",
     Pass: varChildMediaType <> "Podcast" Or (Not(IsBlank(varRequestTitle)) And varRequestTitle <> ""),
     Note: "Enter the podcast title on the Info tab."},
    {Check: "Podcast description provided (Podcast only)",
     Pass: varChildMediaType <> "Podcast" Or (Not(IsBlank(varRequestDescription)) And varRequestDescription <> ""),
     Note: "Enter the podcast description on the Info tab."},
    {Check: "Podcast visual attached (Podcast only)",
     Pass: varChildMediaType <> "Podcast" Or CountRows(CI_PodcastVisual.Attachments) > 0,
     Note: "Attach the podcast visual (square JPEG/PNG) on the Info tab."},
    {Check: "Podcast/episode visuals are JPEG or PNG (Podcast only)",
     Pass: varChildMediaType <> "Podcast" Or (CountRows(Filter(CI_PodcastVisual.Attachments, Not(EndsWith(Lower(Name),".jpg") Or EndsWith(Lower(Name),".jpeg") Or EndsWith(Lower(Name),".png")))) = 0 And CountRows(Filter(CM_EpisodeVisual.Attachments, Not(EndsWith(Lower(Name),".jpg") Or EndsWith(Lower(Name),".jpeg") Or EndsWith(Lower(Name),".png")))) = 0),
     Note: "Only JPEG or PNG images are accepted for the podcast/episode visuals."},
    {Check: "Season and episode number set (Podcast only)",
     Pass: varChildMediaType <> "Podcast" Or (varChildSeasonNumber > 0 And varChildEpisodeNumber > 0),
     Note: "Enter the season and episode number on the Metadata tab."},
    {Check: "Episode summary provided (Podcast only)",
     Pass: varChildMediaType <> "Podcast" Or (Not(IsBlank(varChildEpisodeSummary1)) And varChildEpisodeSummary1 <> ""),
     Note: "Enter the episode summary on the Metadata tab."},
    {Check: "Type of product selected (Video only)",
     Pass: varChildMediaType <> "Video" Or (Not(IsBlank(Coalesce(varChildProductType, varChildProductType1))) And Coalesce(varChildProductType, varChildProductType1) <> ""),
     Note: "Select the type of product on the Info tab."},
    {Check: "Description / summary provided (Video only)",
     Pass: varChildMediaType <> "Video" Or (Not(IsBlank(varChildDescription1)) And varChildDescription1 <> ""),
     Note: "Enter the description on the Info tab."},
    {Check: "Production end date set (Video / Podcast)",
     Pass: (varChildMediaType <> "Video" And varChildMediaType <> "Podcast") Or Not(IsBlank(varChildProductionEndDate)),
     Note: "Set the production end date on the Metadata tab."},
    {Check: "Publication start date set (Video / Podcast)",
     Pass: (varChildMediaType <> "Video" And varChildMediaType <> "Podcast") Or Not(IsBlank(varChildPublicationStartDate)),
     Note: "Set the publication start date on the Metadata tab."},
    {Check: "Publication end date set (Video / Podcast)",
     Pass: (varChildMediaType <> "Video" And varChildMediaType <> "Podcast") Or Not(IsBlank(varChildPublicationEndDate)),
     Note: "Set the publication end date on the Metadata tab."},
    {Check: "Production place provided (Video / Podcast)",
     Pass: (varChildMediaType <> "Video" And varChildMediaType <> "Podcast") Or (Not(IsBlank(varChildProductionPlace1)) And varChildProductionPlace1 <> ""),
     Note: "Enter the production place on the Metadata tab."},
    {Check: "Producer selected (Video / Podcast)",
     Pass: (varChildMediaType <> "Video" And varChildMediaType <> "Podcast") Or (Not(IsBlank(varChildProducer)) And varChildProducer <> ""),
     Note: "Select the producer (contracting authority) on the Metadata tab."},
    {Check: "VTT subtitle file attached (Video, if subtitles provided)",
     Pass: varChildMediaType <> "Video" Or Not(varChildSubtitlesProvided) Or CountRows(Filter(CL_VTTUpload.Attachments, EndsWith(Lower(Name), ".vtt"))) > 0,
     Note: "Subtitles marked as provided - attach at least one .vtt file on the Legal & Docs tab."},
    {Check: "No SRT files attached (Video - VTT only)",
     Pass: varChildMediaType <> "Video" Or (CountRows(Filter(CL_VTTUpload.Attachments, EndsWith(Lower(Name), ".srt"))) = 0 And CountRows(Filter(CL_Annex.Attachments, EndsWith(Lower(Name), ".srt"))) = 0),
     Note: "SRT subtitles are no longer accepted. Remove .srt files and attach .vtt instead."},
    {Check: "Publication end date not earlier than start date (Video / Podcast)",
     Pass: (varChildMediaType <> "Video" And varChildMediaType <> "Podcast") Or IsBlank(varChildPublicationStartDate) Or IsBlank(varChildPublicationEndDate) Or varChildPublicationEndDate >= varChildPublicationStartDate,
     Note: "Publication end date cannot be earlier than the publication start date."},
    {Check: "Production end date not earlier than filming date (Video / Podcast)",
     Pass: (varChildMediaType <> "Video" And varChildMediaType <> "Podcast") Or IsBlank(varChildCaptureDate) Or IsBlank(varChildProductionEndDate) Or varChildProductionEndDate >= varChildCaptureDate,
     Note: "Production end date cannot be earlier than the filming date."},
    {Check: "Model release: if persons appear → forms provided",
     Pass: Not(varChildModelRelease) Or varChildModelReleaseProvided,
     Note: "Recognisable persons declared but model release not confirmed. Attach forms on Legal & Docs."},
    {Check: "Music licence: if music used → documentation provided",
     Pass: Not(varChildMusicUsed) Or varChildMusicLicenceProvided,
     Note: "Music declared but licence/annex not confirmed. Attach on Legal & Docs."},
    {Check: "Pre-existing rights: if declared → annex provided",
     Pass: Not(varChildPreexisting) Or varChildPreexistingProvided,
     Note: "Pre-existing rights declared but annex not confirmed. Attach on Legal & Docs."},
    {Check: "FTP delivery path set on this archive (Photo only)",
     Pass: varChildMediaType <> "Photo" Or (Not(IsBlank(varChildFTPPath1)) And varChildFTPPath1 <> ""),
     Note: "Enter the FTP path on the Info tab."},
    {Check: "Owner / point of contact set on the request",
     Pass: Not(IsBlank(varRequestOwnerContact)) And varRequestOwnerContact <> "",
     Note: "Set the owner on the Request screen."}
)
" /  " & Coalesce(varRequestTitle, "Request") & "  /  " & If(IsBlank(varChildTitle1) Or varChildTitle1 = "", "New archive", varChildTitle1)

User().FullName & " - " & If(
    Find(".", Office365Users.MyProfile().Department) > 0,
    Left(Office365Users.MyProfile().Department, Find(".", Office365Users.MyProfile().Department) - 1),
    Office365Users.MyProfile().Department
)

If(CountIf(colValidations, Not(Pass)) = 0,
    "Ready — all checks passed. Press Save archive to add to your request.",
    Text(CountIf(colValidations, Not(Pass))) & " point(s) missing — resolve before saving")

ClearCollect(colValidations,
    {Check: "Media type is set", Pass: Not(IsBlank(varChildMediaType)) And varChildMediaType <> "", Note: "Select a production type on the Info tab."},
    {Check: "Archive title is provided", Pass: Not(IsBlank(varChildTitle1)) And varChildTitle1 <> "" And varChildTitle1 <> "New archive", Note: "Enter a descriptive title on the Info tab."},
    {Check: "Capture / production date is set", Pass: Not(IsBlank(varChildCaptureDate)), Note: "Set the date on the Info tab (Metadata tab for Photo/Reportage)."},
    {Check: "Language version(s) selected (Video / Podcast only)", Pass: (varChildMediaType <> "Video" And varChildMediaType <> "Podcast") Or (Not(IsBlank(varChildLanguageVersions)) And varChildLanguageVersions <> ""), Note: "Select the language on the Info tab (Video) or Metadata tab (Podcast)."},
    {Check: "No AI-generated voice-over (not accepted)", Pass: Not(varChildAIVoiceover), Note: "⛔ AI voice-over detected. This archive cannot be submitted."},
    {Check: "Contract case (1–6) is selected", Pass: Not(IsBlank(varChildContractCase)) And varChildContractCase <> "", Note: "Select a contract case on the Legal & Docs tab."},
    {Check: "Case 1: both mandatory contracts confirmed", Pass: Left(varChildContractCase, 6) <> "Case 1" Or (varDocFramework And varDocSpecific), Note: "Confirm the signed framework and specific contracts on the Legal & Docs tab."},
    {Check: "Contractor / agency provided (Photo only)", Pass: varChildMediaType <> "Photo" Or (Not(IsBlank(varChildCredits1)) And varChildCredits1 <> ""), Note: "Enter the contractor / agency on the Metadata tab."},
    {Check: "Description provided (Photo only)", Pass: varChildMediaType <> "Photo" Or (Not(IsBlank(varChildDescription1)) And varChildDescription1 <> ""), Note: "Enter the description on the Info tab."},
    {Check: "Place provided (Photo only)", Pass: varChildMediaType <> "Photo" Or (Not(IsBlank(varChildProductionPlace1)) And varChildProductionPlace1 <> ""), Note: "Enter the place on the Metadata tab."},
    {Check: "Photo caption provided (Photo only)", Pass: varChildMediaType <> "Photo" Or (Not(IsBlank(varChildPhotoCaption)) And varChildPhotoCaption <> ""), Note: "Enter the photo caption on the Metadata tab."},
    {Check: "Contracting authority provided (Photo only)", Pass: varChildMediaType <> "Photo" Or (Not(IsBlank(varChildContractingAuthority)) And varChildContractingAuthority <> ""), Note: "Enter the contracting authority on the Metadata tab."},
    {Check: "Podcast title provided (Podcast only)", Pass: varChildMediaType <> "Podcast" Or (Not(IsBlank(varRequestTitle)) And varRequestTitle <> ""), Note: "Enter the podcast title on the Info tab."},
    {Check: "Podcast description provided (Podcast only)", Pass: varChildMediaType <> "Podcast" Or (Not(IsBlank(varRequestDescription)) And varRequestDescription <> ""), Note: "Enter the podcast description on the Info tab."},
    {Check: "Podcast visual attached (Podcast only)", Pass: varChildMediaType <> "Podcast" Or CountRows(CI_PodcastVisual.Attachments) > 0, Note: "Attach the podcast visual (square JPEG/PNG) on the Info tab."},
    {Check: "Podcast/episode visuals are JPEG or PNG (Podcast only)", Pass: varChildMediaType <> "Podcast" Or (CountRows(Filter(CI_PodcastVisual.Attachments, Not(EndsWith(Lower(Name),".jpg") Or EndsWith(Lower(Name),".jpeg") Or EndsWith(Lower(Name),".png")))) = 0 And CountRows(Filter(CM_EpisodeVisual.Attachments, Not(EndsWith(Lower(Name),".jpg") Or EndsWith(Lower(Name),".jpeg") Or EndsWith(Lower(Name),".png")))) = 0), Note: "Only JPEG or PNG images are accepted for the podcast/episode visuals."},
    {Check: "Season and episode number set (Podcast only)", Pass: varChildMediaType <> "Podcast" Or (varChildSeasonNumber > 0 And varChildEpisodeNumber > 0), Note: "Enter the season and episode number on the Metadata tab."},
    {Check: "Episode summary provided (Podcast only)", Pass: varChildMediaType <> "Podcast" Or (Not(IsBlank(varChildEpisodeSummary1)) And varChildEpisodeSummary1 <> ""), Note: "Enter the episode summary on the Metadata tab."},
    {Check: "Type of product selected (Video only)", Pass: varChildMediaType <> "Video" Or (Not(IsBlank(Coalesce(varChildProductType, varChildProductType1))) And Coalesce(varChildProductType, varChildProductType1) <> ""), Note: "Select the type of product on the Info tab."},
    {Check: "Description / summary provided (Video only)", Pass: varChildMediaType <> "Video" Or (Not(IsBlank(varChildDescription1)) And varChildDescription1 <> ""), Note: "Enter the description on the Info tab."},
    {Check: "Production end date set (Video / Podcast)", Pass: (varChildMediaType <> "Video" And varChildMediaType <> "Podcast") Or Not(IsBlank(varChildProductionEndDate)), Note: "Set the production end date on the Metadata tab."},
    {Check: "Publication start date set (Video / Podcast)", Pass: (varChildMediaType <> "Video" And varChildMediaType <> "Podcast") Or Not(IsBlank(varChildPublicationStartDate)), Note: "Set the publication start date on the Metadata tab."},
    {Check: "Publication end date set (Video / Podcast)", Pass: (varChildMediaType <> "Video" And varChildMediaType <> "Podcast") Or Not(IsBlank(varChildPublicationEndDate)), Note: "Set the publication end date on the Metadata tab."},
    {Check: "Production place provided (Video / Podcast)", Pass: (varChildMediaType <> "Video" And varChildMediaType <> "Podcast") Or (Not(IsBlank(varChildProductionPlace1)) And varChildProductionPlace1 <> ""), Note: "Enter the production place on the Metadata tab."},
    {Check: "Producer selected (Video / Podcast)", Pass: (varChildMediaType <> "Video" And varChildMediaType <> "Podcast") Or (Not(IsBlank(varChildProducer)) And varChildProducer <> ""), Note: "Select the producer (contracting authority) on the Metadata tab."},
    {Check: "VTT subtitle file attached (Video, if subtitles provided)", Pass: varChildMediaType <> "Video" Or Not(varChildSubtitlesProvided) Or CountRows(Filter(CL_VTTUpload.Attachments, EndsWith(Lower(Name), ".vtt"))) > 0, Note: "Subtitles marked as provided - attach at least one .vtt file on the Legal & Docs tab."},
    {Check: "No SRT files attached (Video - VTT only)", Pass: varChildMediaType <> "Video" Or (CountRows(Filter(CL_VTTUpload.Attachments, EndsWith(Lower(Name), ".srt"))) = 0 And CountRows(Filter(CL_Annex.Attachments, EndsWith(Lower(Name), ".srt"))) = 0), Note: "SRT subtitles are no longer accepted. Remove .srt files and attach .vtt instead."},
    {Check: "Publication end date not earlier than start date (Video / Podcast)", Pass: (varChildMediaType <> "Video" And varChildMediaType <> "Podcast") Or IsBlank(varChildPublicationStartDate) Or IsBlank(varChildPublicationEndDate) Or varChildPublicationEndDate >= varChildPublicationStartDate, Note: "Publication end date cannot be earlier than the publication start date."},
    {Check: "Production end date not earlier than filming date (Video / Podcast)", Pass: (varChildMediaType <> "Video" And varChildMediaType <> "Podcast") Or IsBlank(varChildCaptureDate) Or IsBlank(varChildProductionEndDate) Or varChildProductionEndDate >= varChildCaptureDate, Note: "Production end date cannot be earlier than the filming date."},
    {Check: "Model release: if persons appear → forms provided", Pass: Not(varChildModelRelease) Or varChildModelReleaseProvided, Note: "Recognisable persons declared but model release not confirmed. Attach forms on Legal & Docs."},
    {Check: "Music licence: if music used → documentation provided", Pass: Not(varChildMusicUsed) Or varChildMusicLicenceProvided, Note: "Music declared but licence/annex not confirmed. Attach on Legal & Docs."},

If(CountIf(colValidations, Not(Pass)) = 0, "", Text(CountIf(colValidations, Not(Pass))) & " check(s) must pass before saving")

With(
    {existingRec: LookUp(colArchives, ArchiveId = varCurrentChildId)},
    RemoveIf(colArchives, ArchiveId = varCurrentChildId);
    Collect(colArchives, {
        ArchiveId: varCurrentChildId,
        SPId: Coalesce(existingRec.SPId, varCurrentChildSPId, 0),
        Title: If(IsBlank(varChildTitle1) Or varChildTitle1 = "", "New archive", varChildTitle1),
        MediaType: varChildMediaType,
        Description: varChildDescription1,
        CaptureDate: varChildCaptureDate,
        ProductionPlace: varChildProductionPlace1,
        ProductType: varChildProductType,
        SeriesTitle: varChildSeriesTitle1,
        EpisodeTitle: varChildEpisodeTitle,
        EpisodeSummary: varChildEpisodeSummary1,
        SeasonNumber: varChildSeasonNumber,
        EpisodeNumber: varChildEpisodeNumber,
        ProductionEndDate: varChildProductionEndDate,
        PublicationStartDate: varChildPublicationStartDate,
        PublicationEndDate: varChildPublicationEndDate,
        ReferenceLinks: varChildLinks1,
        Tags: varChildTags,
                    PhotoCaption: varChildPhotoCaption, ProductionTitle: varChildTitle1,
                    Credits: varChildCredits1,
                    ContractingAuthority: varChildContractingAuthority,
                    ExecProducer: varChildExecProducer,
                    Producer: varChildProducerSel,
        FTPPath: varChildFTPPath1,
        LanguageVersions: varChildLanguageVersions,
        AIVoiceover: varChildAIVoiceover,
        ContractCase: varChildContractCase,
        ContractCase1Sub: varChildContractCase1Sub,
        ModelRelease: varChildModelRelease,
        ModelReleaseProvided: varChildModelReleaseProvided,
        MusicUsed: varChildMusicUsed,
        MusicLicenceProvided: varChildMusicLicenceProvided,
        Preexisting: varChildPreexisting,
        PreexistingProvided: varChildPreexistingProvided
    })
);
If(
    Not(IsBlank(varCurrentRequest)) And varCurrentRequest.ID > 0,
    IfError(
        With(
            {spId: Coalesce(LookUp(colArchives, ArchiveId = varCurrentChildId).SPId, 0)},
            With(
                {
                    savedMedia: Patch(
                        AVCentralDepositMediaItems,
                        If(
                            spId = 0,
                            Defaults(AVCentralDepositMediaItems),
                            LookUp(AVCentralDepositMediaItems, ID = spId)
                        ),
                        {
                            CD_MediaNumber: If(spId = 0, With({yr: Text(Year(Today()))}, yr & "-" & Right("000" & Text(Value(Right(Coalesce(First(Sort(Filter(AVCentralDepositMediaItems, StartsWith(CD_MediaNumber, yr & "-")), CD_MediaNumber, SortOrder.Descending)).CD_MediaNumber, yr & "-0000"), 4)) + 1), 4)), LookUp(AVCentralDepositMediaItems, ID = spId).CD_MediaNumber),
                            Description: varChildDescription1,
                            // Multi-select Choice columns (per connector schema): patch as Table({Value:"..."}).
                            MediaType: Table({Value: varChildMediaType}),
                                                CaptureDate: varChildCaptureDate,
                            ProductionPlace: varChildProductionPlace1,
                            ProductType: If(
                                IsBlank(varChildProductType) Or varChildProductType = "",
                                Blank(),
                                Table({Value: varChildProductType})
                            ),
                            SeriesTitle: varChildSeriesTitle1,
                            EpisodeTitle: varChildEpisodeTitle,
                            EpisodeSummary: varChildEpisodeSummary1,
                            SeasonNumber: varChildSeasonNumber,
                            EpisodeNumber: varChildEpisodeNumber,
                            ProductionEndDate: varChildProductionEndDate,
                            PublicationStartDate: varChildPublicationStartDate,
                            PublicationEndDate: varChildPublicationEndDate,
                            ReferenceLinks: varChildLinks1,
                            Tags: varChildTags,
                            FTPPath: varChildFTPPath1,
                            LanguageVersions: Table({Value: varChildLanguageVersions}),
                            // AIVoiceover column is TEXT; var is Boolean by convention, converted here only.
                            AIVoiceover: If(varChildAIVoiceover, "Yes", "No"),
                            ContractCase: Table({Value: varChildContractCase}),
                            ContractCase1Sub: If(
                                IsBlank(varChildContractCase1Sub) Or varChildContractCase1Sub = "",
                                Blank(),
                                Table({Value: varChildContractCase1Sub})
                            ),
                            MusicUsed: varChildMusicUsed,
                            MusicLicenseProvided: varChildMusicLicenceProvided,
                            PreexistingRightsProvided: varChildPreexistingProvided,
                            ModelReleaseProvided: varChildModelReleaseProvided,
                            CreditContact: varChildCredits1,
                                        ContractingAuthority: varChildContractingAuthority,
                                        ExecProducerName: varChildExecProducer,
                                        Producer: If(IsBlank(varChildProducerSel), Blank(), ForAll(varChildProducerSel As u, {'@odata.type': "#Microsoft.Azure.Connectors.SharePoint.SPListExpandedUser", Claims: "i:0#.f|membership|" & Lower(u.Mail), DisplayName: u.DisplayName, Email: u.Mail, Department: "", JobTitle: "", Picture: ""})),
                                        PhotoCaption: varChildPhotoCaption, ProductionTitle: varChildTitle1,
                                        DepositStatus: Table({Value: "Pending Approval"}),
                            ParentRequest: varCurrentRequest.RequestNumber
                        }
                    )
                },
                UpdateIf(colArchives, ArchiveId = varCurrentChildId, {SPId: savedMedia.ID});
                Notify("Media saved to SharePoint.", NotificationType.Success);
                Navigate(RequestScreen)
            )
        ),
        Notify("Save failed: " & FirstError.Message, NotificationType.Error)
    ),
    Notify("Media added to request. Save or submit the request to persist media to SharePoint.", NotificationType.Success);
    Navigate(RequestScreen)
)

If(
    Not(IsBlank(varCurrentRequest)) And varCurrentRequest.ID > 0,
    IfError(
        With(

                            ),
                            SeriesTitle: varChildSeriesTitle,
                            EpisodeTitle: varChildEpisodeTitle,
                            EpisodeSummary: varChildEpisodeSummary,
                            SeasonNumber: varChildSeasonNumber,
                            EpisodeNumber: varChildEpisodeNumber,
                            ProductionEndDate: varChildProductionEndDate,
                            PublicationStartDate: varChildPublicationStartDate,
                            PublicationEndDate: varChildPublicationEndDate,
                            ReferenceLinks: varChildLinks,
                            Tags: varChildTags,
                            FTPPath: varChildFTPPath1,
                            LanguageVersions: Table({Value: varChildLanguageVersions}),
                            // AIVoiceover column is TEXT; var is Boolean by convention, converted here only.
                            AIVoiceover: If(varChildAIVoiceover, "Yes", "No"),
                            ContractCase: Table({Value: varChildContractCase}),
                            ContractCase1Sub: If(
                                IsBlank(varChildContractCase1Sub) Or varChildContractCase1Sub = "",
                                Blank(),
                                Table({Value: varChildContractCase1Sub})
                            ),
                            MusicUsed: varChildMusicUsed,
                            MusicLicenseProvided: varChildMusicLicenceProvided,
                            PreexistingRightsProvided: varChildPreexistingProvided,
                            ModelReleaseProvided: varChildModelReleaseProvided,
                            DepositStatus: Table({Value: "Pending Approval"}),
                            ParentRequest: varCurrentRequest.RequestNumber
                        }
                    )
                },
                UpdateIf(colArchives, ArchiveId = varCurrentChildId, {SPId: savedMedia.ID});
                Notify("Archive saved to SharePoint.", NotificationType.Success);
                Navigate(RequestScreen)
            )
        ),
        Notify("Save failed: " & FirstError.Message, NotificationType.Error)
    ),
    Notify("Archive added to request. Save or submit the request to persist media to SharePoint.", NotificationType.Success);
